desc: 纯色硬切分章版面拆解无接触感应补水与恒湿暖雾，容量时长度数全留白
leaf: 电磁感应补水智能恒湿加湿器
name: 矢车菊蓝暖杏分章感应补水加湿器款

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里用干净的纯色分章主图一眼赢得点击
把换季干燥带来的日常困扰收成四格占位，逼出补湿动机而不做功效宣称
shots.textZone: four caption slots under the four wells plus one lead line under the headline

shots.intent: 一秒把整套功能主张收进六枚实心圆碟，承接首屏后不流失
shots.textZone: top band headline plus one caption under each of the six discs

shots.intent: 用同机位双联侧视把传统水箱结垢漏水与无接触补水的差别讲清楚
shots.textZone: one short line under each panel and one closing line on the right panel

shots.intent: 用低掠角微距证明水箱与底座无机械接触的结构卖点
shots.textZone: one short label on the empty disc only

shots.intent: 在唯一暖章里给出进风滤带的洁净质感，替换冷色疲劳
shots.textZone: upper-left two-line headline plus one label on the empty disc

shots.intent: 把机器放进寒冷季节的居家角落，让买家自我代入使用位置
用枕边低角交代夜间无扰使用，替掉原页的星空氛围板
回答容量与续航类疑问，但只给两只空白数字井由下游按实参填
shots.textZone: top band headline plus one label under each blank well

shots.intent: 用三格留空细节位与空标签降风险，替掉不可核实的资质宣称
shots.textZone: one label on each of the three empty discs plus one headline on the caption band

shots.intent: 以干净的分章收口与一枚留空按钮位替代原页的促销贴片
shots.textZone: upper closing line plus one empty outlined button plaque beneath it

style.backgroundSystem: full-bleed flat single-colour chapter fields butted together with one hard horizontal seam, the set cycling through cloud-grey #E4E7EB, cornflower #4A63AD, pale sky #A9D8EC and apricot #F1C9A9, one solid terracotta arch shape #C9805C anchoring the right edge of the warm chapter; no gradient falloff, no frosted overlay plate, no photographic depth inside an information chapter
style.iconSystem: solid flat chips only, an off-white #F4F6F8 disc inside a #A9D8EC ring, plus hairline leader lines ending in one small solid terracotta dot #C9805C; no line-art pictograms, no 3D or glossy icons, nothing that reads as a certification mark
style.lightingSystem: cool 5600K soft frontal key from the upper right with a broad left bounce fill, short tight contact shadow directly under the base, even flat illumination inside every colour chapter, no warm lamp cast and no dramatic specular streak
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent flat colour-chapter environmental-appliance visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-grey chapter field #E4E7EB, cornflower chapter field #4A63AD, pale sky chapter field #A9D8EC, apricot chapter field #F1C9A9, one terracotta accent #C9805C and ink-blue text #232B3D; full-bleed single-colour fields butted together with one hard horizontal seam and one solid terracotta arch, never a gradient falloff, never a frosted overlay plate and never photographic depth blur inside an information chapter; cool 5600K soft frontal key from the upper right with a broad left bounce fill, a short tight contact shadow under the base and no warm cast; one modern geometric sans-serif with a thin left-edge vertical rule, one blank square chapter chip, a two-line stacked headline hairlined under its lead line and caption slots along the base band; solid flat chips, an off-white #F4F6F8 disc inside a #A9D8EC ring, and hairline leader lines ending in one small solid #C9805C dot; stable upright product scale on the same front axis with the control ring, display panel and water window always blank and mist only ever a light translucent plume; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no rendered readouts, no promotional corner badges, no invented figures.
noDrift: no brand wordmark, English category eyebrow, store corner badge, promotional sticker or QR block
no digits, units, readouts, capacity or runtime figures, humidity percentages, coverage areas, decibel values or temperature degrees drawn on any disc, ring, chip, well or screen
no colour palette changes and no warm wood, marble, mint or gradient-glass surface replacing the flat chapter fields
no mixed fonts, no serif, no handwritten or cartoon lettering, no drop shadow behind headline text
no inconsistent key direction and no mismatched chip or leader-line weights between chapters
no dense smoke or fog wall standing in for mist
style.presentationRules: the unit stays upright at one true scale on the same front axis, never re-scaled and never clipped by the chapter edge; the control ring, any display panel and the water window always read as blank unlit surfaces with no glyph, digit or graduation; mist is only ever a light translucent plume that thins as it rises
style.surfaceSystem: matte lime-plaster pedestal #EFF1F4 and a cool studio floor #CFD5DC; a pale linen strip #E7EAF0 is the only soft-goods surface and only in the bedroom chapter
style.typography: one modern geometric sans-serif: a thin vertical rule at the left edge carrying one blank square chapter chip, a two-line stacked headline with one hairline under its lead line, four caption slots along the base band; headline 32-42pt, sub-line 16-18pt, labels 12-14pt, all copy as placeholders and no English category word printed in frame
